nem.text: Avila, Eladamri's daughter, is poisoned by her former lover, now a Phyrexian agent, who delivers her body to Phyrexia.
There Abcal-dro reconstructs her body as a cyborg, names her Belbe and implants the Eye of Yawgmoth, and sends her as an emissary to oversee the Evincar succession contest.
